THE_HEADLINE_RESULT.what_changed: Every prior comparison measured the challenger against the ALL-CAP BASELINE. The owner's standard measures against the EXPANDING PRIOR. Same 30 games, different reference, opposite conclusion.

expanding_prior.note: a constant .527 probability. It picks home every game and home went 22-8 across these two nights.

all_cap_baseline.reading: a WINNING record whose entire skill interval lies below zero. The probabilities subtracted information relative to the base rate. This is precisely the combination the standard exists to surface, and it appeared on the first real run.

challenger_starter_informed.reading: positive sign, interval spanning zero, no distance from the prior at all

THE_HEADLINE_RESULT.the_conclusion_that_matters: Almost the entire -0.00934 advantage the challenger showed over the all-CAP baseline was the BASELINE BEING BAD, not the challenger being good. Against the correct reference the challenger's skill is +0.00094 with an interval spanning zero. Nine days of MLB work has not yet produced a model that beats a constant .527 by a measurable amount. Reporting the -0.00934 without the prior comparison would have described progress that does not exist.

paired_postgame.reading: Four of the five largest gains are moves TOWARD HOME on nights home teams went 22-8; three of the five largest losses are moves TOWARD AWAY. The directional confound reported yesterday is not softened by looking game by game — it is the shape of the whole result.

two_defects_found_by_running_on_real_dat: NO MATERIALITY GUARD: +0.00094 skill on 30 games was graded PREDICTIVE_PROGRESS because the sign was positive. A slate-clustered interval on the skill score now governs, and the verdict consults the interval BEFORE the point estimate's sign — so a negative point estimate whose interval spans zero is NO_PREDICTIVE_PROGRESS, not NEGATIVE_SKILL. Overclaiming in the negative direction is the same error as overclaiming in the positive one.

CALIBRATION FITTED TO A NEAR-CONSTANT FORECAST: the expanding-prior arm drew an intercept of +189 and a slope of -2139, which reads as catastrophic miscalibration and is a degenerate fit. An exact-equality guard MISSED it because the prior drifts a hair between slate dates; the floor is now 0.1pp of spread and the result is reported as UNDEFINED, not miscalibrated.
what_this_does_not_do: No new model was built. The MLB challenger described in the mandate is not yet implemented.
Nothing is promoted. Gate 0/100 NO_PROMOTE, ledger $0, execution UNAUTHORIZED, wager NO.
